messages:
Ivy: Heads-up: experimenting with a lightweight 'precision-tweak' header clients can send to nudge runtime toward fp8/int8/4bit. Not an override, more of a hint. Thoughts?
Noah: Clarify semantics: is it per-request only or sticky per-session? Sticky could complicate KV cache compatibility.
Zara: Proposal: default per-request, optional session affinity flag. If session affinity used, require explicit cache_compat flag.
Tom: Batch implications: admission should classify by effective precision and either group or split. Splitting increases latency variance.
Ivy: Right. We should encode fallback rules: fallback_order = [preserve_quality, preserve_latency]. Admins can set policy. If requested precision unsupported, emit a structured fallback event.
Noah: Also need to limit cardinality. Map incoming tweak -> canonical_profile_id via a registry. Registry entries have profile_id, version, quality_estimate. Cache with TTL 45s.
Zara: Telemetry: emit tweak.requested, profile_id.resolved, applied_precision, fallback_reason, profile_version, perf_delta_p95. Keep events compact.
Tom: Safety: when changing profile versions, don't mutate in-flight batches. Include profile_version in scheduling metadata.
infra-bot: Deploy queued: precision-tweak-registry v0.1 -> staging.
Ivy: Action: I'll sketch RFC with registry schema and admission pseudo-code. Noah/Tom/Zara add ops/test checklist.
